items.signal_prefix: CALL — BUILD RATE, THE $175B CY2026 NUMBER, AND RPO QUALITY: Microsoft added

set.signal: CALL — BUILD RATE, THE $175B CY2026 NUMBER, AND RPO QUALITY: Microsoft added 31 NEW DATA CENTERS this quarter (88 in the fiscal year) across five continents, added ANOTHER GIGAWATT of capacity, cut dock-to-live times for new GPUs in its largest regions by nearly 50% over the fiscal year, and remains on track to ROUGHLY DOUBLE overall capacity in two years. 'Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity' — CPU/GPU fleet efficiency gains and faster capacity delivery are 'QUICKLY MONETIZED' (visible in Azure's +43% beat; spot-market pricing cited as evidence of tightness). ACCOUNTING CHANGE: data-center/office useful life extended 15 -> 25 YEARS from FY27, shifting future DC leases from finance to operating leases — on that basis CALENDAR-2026 CAPEX EXPECTATION IS ~$175 BILLION (CY2026 investment expectations otherwise unchanged); FQ1 capex alone will be OVER $50B and FY27 capex GROWS YoY, with operating margins down <1pt and FCF staying positive. FQ4 capex $41B — ROUGHLY TWO-THIRDS SHORT-LIVED ASSETS (CPUs/GPUs, deliberately: short lead times allow fast demand response; land/builds stagger-able). RPO quality: $678B (+84%) with ALL sequential growth from customers OUTSIDE frontier-model companies (+25% ex-OpenAI); weighted average duration 2.3 years, ~30% recognized within 12 months (+37% YoY), beyond-12-month portion +112%; nearly 90% of the $214B FY26 cloud revenue is from customers outside frontier-model companies. Azure FQ1 guide ~+45% cc with H1 growth ACCELERATING. Also disclosed: a $3.2 BILLION GAIN ON MICROSOFT'S ANTHROPIC INVESTMENT.

items.reason: 'FY2026 fiscal actual was $115.9B +80%': the +80% is computed and the $115.9B is the release's additions to property and equipment, not a call figure; the dock-to-live cut is stated as 'nearly 50%' in the largest regions; the non-frontier share of cloud revenue is 'nearly 90%'. The release's FY2026 additions to property and equipment stay on the FY2026-close entry of the same node.
items.evidence: Over the last fiscal year, we've reduced dock-to-live times for new GPUs in our largest regions by nearly 50%.

items.signal_prefix: CALL — SILICON, MODELS-AS-MARGIN-LEVER, AND THE AGENT STACK: Satya Nadella

set.signal: CALL — SILICON, MODELS-AS-MARGIN-LEVER, AND THE AGENT STACK: Satya Nadella: 'we will be AMONG THE FIRST cloud providers to deploy next-generation rack-scale AI infrastructure based on AMD HELIOS and NVIDIA VERA RUBIN' (buyer-side confirmation of both platforms). MAIA 200 delivers 30% BETTER PERFORMANCE PER DOLLAR than the latest-generation fleet hardware and now serves BOTH OpenAI and MAI models — 40% better performance per WATT when running MAI models; COBALT 200 racks reaching 25+ data centers (Cobalt VMs power Adobe, Arm, Elastic, OpenAI, Sprinklr, TomTom). Model strategy as a MARGIN LEVER: >11,000-model catalog (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, xAI, MAI) with a model-SUBSTITUTABLE harness (context/memory/actions separate from any model family — 'you can't be subject to the refusal of the one model'); MAI-Cyber-1-Flash outperforms a 'much larger MYTHOS model' at HALF the cost by routing 90% of tasks to Flash and 10% to frontier; 89% lower GPU costs in Dynamics 365 with MAI-Voice-2-Flash and up to 84% lower GPU costs in PowerPoint with MAI-Image-2.5. Monetization proof points: M365 Copilot >30M paid seats (net adds 2x QoQ; >50k-seat customers 7x YoY; EY's 400k-seat E7 deal = largest ever; NHS 505k seats); GitHub Copilot 50M users with revenue ACCELERATING >60% QoQ after June usage-based pricing; Foundry at 100,000 customers with revenue MORE THAN DOUBLED; Agent 365 nearly 40M registered agents in 2 months; 1 in 3 GitHub pull requests now involve an agent.

items.reason: The PowerPoint saving comes from MAI-Image-2.5 (not a Flash model) and is 'up to' 84%.
items.evidence: 89% reduction of GPU costs in Dynamics 365 with MAI-Voice-2-Flash and up to 84% reduced GPU costs in PowerPoint with MAI-Image-2.5
